title: Diagnosis of Brucella Infections using in-house PCR
author: Sunaina H. Aghanashini
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Collect patient blood samples
steps.instruction: Collect whole blood from 19 patients over the period 2017‑2019 who are seropositive and/or culture‑positive.

steps.title: Extract DNA from blood
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from each blood sample using a commercial spin‑column purification kit, following the kit protocol.

steps.title: Amplify BSCP31 gene by PCR
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the Brucella‑specific BSCP31 gene using primers B4 and B5; run the assay so that results are obtained in less than 24 hours.
